ai.summary: The page https://www.nature.org/en-us/ loaded with HTTP 200 in a headless browser. No FundraiseUp installation code was found in the page source, and no FundraiseUp widget request was recorded. The FundraiseUp global object is not defined at runtime. No Google Tag Manager container and no GA4 measurement ID were seen loading or sending hits. A Meta Pixel and a OneTrust consent tool were found. No other donation tool was found. The browser did not click any buttons, so checkout behavior was not tested. A donate page at https://tnc.colabore.org/analytics-test/single_step returned HTTP 200 with donation content in the HTML. Verdict: not installed, because installation code is missing.

customer_email.subject: Next steps to connect donations on your website
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us to set up online donations. We checked your page at https://www.nature.org/en-us/. The check did not find the donation installation code in the page source, so donations cannot be connected yet.

Please do the following:

1. Add the installation code to the page source. We will send you the code.
2. Share your Google Tag Manager container ID and your GA4 measurement ID, if you use them. If you do not use them, please let us know.

Once these are in place, we will run the check again.

Thank you,
Onboarding Team
